# MCP Tool Shop

> Open-source tooling for local-first AI development: MCP servers, command-line tools, training and dataset pipelines, and game-production tooling that run on your own hardware. MIT licensed.

Organization: https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org
Website and tool catalog: https://mcptoolshop.com
npm scope: https://www.npmjs.com/search?q=%40mcptoolshop (packages are published as `@mcptoolshop/<name>`)
Support policy: https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/.github/blob/main/SUPPORT.md
Security policy: https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md

## What the organization is

MCP Tool Shop is an independent software studio. It builds the tools it uses to develop AI-assisted software and games, and publishes them as open source. Core functionality never requires an API key or a hosted service; tools run on a workstation GPU with Ollama, ComfyUI, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Optional cloud routing, where it exists, is opt-in with local fallback.

## Areas of work

### MCP servers
- tool-compass: semantic MCP tool discovery; find tools by intent. `npx @mcptoolshop/tool-compass` or `pip install tool-compass`. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/tool-compass
- ollama-intern-mcp: delegate bulk analysis to a local Ollama model from Claude Code; 42 job-shaped tools with durable artifacts. `npx ollama-intern-mcp`. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/ollama-intern-mcp
- mcp-voice-soundboard: text-to-speech MCP server; 48 voices, 9 languages, SSML-lite, multi-speaker dialogue. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/mcp-voice-soundboard
- polyglot-mcp: local GPU translation MCP server (TranslateGemma via Ollama, 55 languages). https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/polyglot-mcp
- plain-sight: image description MCP server and CLI (Florence-2, local). https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/plain-sight

### Training and datasets
- backpropagate: headless LLM fine-tuning with VRAM-aware defaults and GGUF export. `pip install backpropagate`. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/backpropagate
- style-dataset-lab: canon-aligned visual dataset production: snapshots, splits, training packages, eval scorecards. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/style-dataset-lab
- repo-dataset: contamination-checked training datasets from code and visual repos. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/repo-dataset
- backprop-trace: deterministic verifier for neural-network training steps. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/backprop-trace

### Image and media pipelines
- comfy-headless: drive ComfyUI from Python; builds and runs API-format graphs for image, video, 3D, and audio. `pip install comfy-headless`. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/comfy-headless
- comfy-preflight: a gate that halts a ComfyUI submission that would produce a known-wrong result. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/comfy-preflight
- sprite-foundry: headless sprite generation pipeline (ComfyUI + SQLite + Godot finish lab). https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/sprite-foundry
- armature: GLB-authored previz and control sequences for image-to-video models. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/armature
- audiobooker: EPUB/TXT/PDF/DOCX to multi-voice narrated audiobooks. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/audiobooker

### Agent infrastructure
- role-os: multi-Claude orchestration: 61 roles, team packs, missions, structured evidence. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/role-os
- loadout-os: routes the right memories and rules to a coding agent on demand. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/loadout-os
- prism-verify: runtime LLM verifier; family-different, reasoning-stripped, signed receipts. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/prism-verify
- claude-guardian: log rotation, watchdog, crash bundles, and MCP self-awareness for Claude Code. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/claude-guardian
- research-os: local-first research control plane with gated source packs and claim truth. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/research-os

### Developer tooling
- shipcheck: release quality gate: Ship Gate checklist, error contract, templates. `npx @mcptoolshop/shipcheck audit`. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/shipcheck
- site-theme: multi-template Astro toolkit for landing pages and docs. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/site-theme
- repo-knowledge: relational repo catalog with full-text search and MCP access. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/repo-knowledge
- registry-stats: download stats across npm, PyPI, NuGet, VS Code Marketplace, and Docker Hub. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/registry-stats
- npm-launcher: GitHub-release binary launcher with cache and SHA256 verification. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/npm-launcher

### Games and game tooling
- ai-rpg-engine: simulation-native toolkit for deterministic RPG worlds. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/ai-rpg-engine
- world-forge: 2D/2.5D world authoring with export lanes for AI RPG Engine, Unreal Engine 5, and Godot 4. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/world-forge
- motif: adaptive soundtrack studio for interactive game music. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/motif
- saints-mile: a frontier JRPG for the terminal. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/saints-mile
- roll: RPG dice engine with probability analysis and loot tables. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/roll

### Ledger and verification
- attestia: financial truth infrastructure for decentralized systems. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/attestia
- xrpl-lab: XRPL training workbook; learn by doing, prove by artifact. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/xrpl-lab
- xrpl-camp: learn the XRP Ledger in one sitting with real transactions. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/xrpl-camp
- repomesh: verify releases and anchors across repo networks. https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/repomesh

### Sister organization: dogfood-lab (https://github.com/dogfood-lab)
Testing methods for AI-assisted software live in a second organization owned by the same studio.
- testing-os: operating system for testing in the AI era; provenance-confirmed evidence stores and learning loops. `npx @dogfood-lab/dogfood-swarm`. https://github.com/dogfood-lab/testing-os
- study-swarm: protocol for grounding design decisions in cited research and verifying every citation with a different model family. `npx @dogfood-lab/study-swarm`. https://github.com/dogfood-lab/study-swarm

## Engineering standards

- Every tagged release passes the shipcheck gate: security policy and threat model, structured errors with exit codes, current documentation and changelog, clean packaging.
- Semantic versioning; releases are tagged on GitHub and published to npm or PyPI from CI.
- CI on ubuntu-latest, path-filtered, with concurrency groups; no telemetry in any tool.
- Most repositories ship READMEs in English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, and Brazilian Portuguese.
- Each repository states its lane: Shipped (tagged releases, CI, install command), In development (active, pre-1.0), or Archive (kept in the prototypes repository).

## Technology

Python, TypeScript, Rust, C#, GDScript (Godot 4), Astro. Runtimes and protocols: MCP, Ollama, ComfyUI, SQLite, CUDA. Developed on Windows with NVIDIA hardware; most tools are cross-platform.

## Using this with an AI agent

MCP servers from this organization can be added to any MCP client configuration. tool-compass indexes the others and lets an agent discover tools by describing the task. Each repository has its own README, and most also carry an llms.txt.
